name: InterCode
description: InterCode is a framework and benchmark for interactive coding with execution feedback, designed as a reinforcement learning environment. It supports multiple programming languages and enables evaluation of interactive code generation methods using execution feedback to improve code correctness and generation quality.
reputation: A recent benchmark for interactive code generation with execution feedback, but not yet a widely established standard in the coding benchmark ecosystem.
notes: Provides a flexible, language-agnostic environment using Docker for safe code execution and supports new interactive coding tasks.
